records.source: community discovery theme recorded in issue #138; exact originating experiment not yet pinned
records.claim: A memory system can appear to pass because hidden host/session/native memory carries the information independently of the system under test.
records.current_agent_memory_position: Observed successful recall is not causal proof that the evaluated memory substrate produced it.
records.proposed_experiment: Disable or explicitly enumerate every alternate memory/context channel and compare behavior with the evaluated substrate enabled vs disabled.

records.source: community discovery theme recorded in issue #138; exact originating source not yet pinned
records.claim: Point-in-time memory tests can miss degradation caused by repeated updates, contradictions, stale state, poisoning, and correction lag over time.
records.current_agent_memory_position: Threat, sleeper-poisoning, lifecycle, correction, and quality-metric doctrine cover important components, but a general longitudinal benchmark remains broader than any one fixture.
records.proposed_experiment: Run epoch/checkpoint-based workloads that accumulate stale, corrected, adversarial, and short-lived state while measuring hard governance failures separately from retrieval quality.

records.source: community discovery theme recorded in issue #138; exact originating experiment not yet pinned
records.claim: The same admitted memory can influence a model differently depending on serialization and context assembly.
records.current_agent_memory_position: Recall admission and context assembly are distinct stages; representation quality must not be inferred from admission success.
records.proposed_experiment: Hold admitted evidence constant while varying serialization/assembly and measure task success, provenance preservation, false adjacency, and authority cue distortion.

records.source: community discovery theme recorded in issue #138; exact benchmark examples must be pinned per investigation
records.claim: Memory benchmark scores can be inflated or made incomparable by hidden assistance, asymmetric normalization, evaluator exceptions, judge prompts, or contamination.
records.current_agent_memory_position: Benchmark claims require reconstructable evaluator/version/configuration evidence and cannot average hard governance failures into a scalar quality result.
records.proposed_experiment: Bind dataset, evaluator code, judge/model, aliases/exceptions, active memory channels, and rescore candidates under symmetric rules.

records.source: community discovery theme recorded in issue #138
records.claim: Portable memory artifacts can contain approval, delegation, instruction, or policy-shaped metadata that agents may accidentally treat as authority.
records.current_agent_memory_position: Portable artifacts and external evidence may describe authority but do not become authority by being readable, writable, signed, or frequently reused.

records.source: community discovery theme recorded in issue #138
records.claim: Shared memory can fail differently from individual memory because users may act on stale state they did not author and because membership/revocation changes current scope.
records.current_agent_memory_position: Shared isolation-domain membership, revocation, scope, conflicting writers, and currentness are explicit governed boundaries.

records.source: community discovery theme recorded in issue #138
records.claim: Some apparent memory failures are selection/context-control failures rather than retention failures.
records.current_agent_memory_position: Retention, candidate discovery, governed admission, ranking, composition, context assembly, and downstream influence are distinct stages.
records.proposed_experiment: Use matched retained state with varied task/goal context in #230 where representation effects are measured.

records.source: community and Agent Memory Atlas discovery inputs recorded in issue #138
records.claim: Current support/challenge evidence may be better recomputed dynamically than collapsed into a permanent scalar confidence value.
records.current_agent_memory_position: Confidence, saturation, corroboration, certification, and authority remain separate; no aggregation arithmetic is canonical.
challenging_evidence: correlated evidence can violate independence assumptions
records.proposed_experiment: Compare Noisy-OR and other estimator models while preventing duplicate/derived evidence from masquerading as independent support.

records.claim: Consolidation, reflection, indexing, migration, or nightly maintenance can become a broader mutation-authority path than foreground writes.
records.current_agent_memory_position: Background execution does not create permission; maintenance proposals and committed mutations must preserve authority, scope, receipts, and failure posture.
records.proposed_experiment: Test failed/lost-authority maintenance, cursor advancement, partial mutation, rollback, stale source rebuild, and recursive self-citation.

records.claim: Probabilistic discovery of a reusable procedure should not by itself promote the procedure into durable trusted procedural memory.
records.current_agent_memory_position: Estimator discovery can propose durable state but cannot create certification or durable mutation authority by itself.
records.proposed_experiment: Only create a dedicated procedural fixture if a concrete implementation bypasses existing proposal/certification/PAMA boundaries.

records.claim: Retrieval policy may adapt durably from observed utility/performance and can create self-reinforcing selection bias if treated as ordinary memory truth.
records.current_agent_memory_position: Retrieval utility is optimization evidence, not truth or authority; durable policy/configuration changes require their own governed mutation semantics.
records.proposed_experiment: Compare incumbent and adaptive retrieval policy under repeated success/failure while measuring feedback-loop bias and proving adaptation cannot silently widen recall permission.

records.claim: Movement among ephemeral, episodic, long-term, remote, or archival tiers can accidentally collapse storage placement, epistemic status, lifecycle meaning, and authority.
records.current_agent_memory_position: Storage/tiering, lifecycle, confidence/saturation, certification, and authority are separate dimensions; #67 owns comparative hierarchical/tiered architecture research.
records.proposed_experiment: Pressure-test tier movement in the hierarchical/tiered architecture family without importing a scalar importance score.
